notes.title: Conveyance Release Date
notes.notes:
We're excited to advise Conveyance will be released February 10, 2022!

This leaves us just 7 more weeks to tighten all the machine mounts, solder the processor chips and check for any dodgy conveyor belts.

In the meantime we've added some new posts in our Discussions area, including some links to new tutorial videos. Please grab an Eggnog and take a look...

Tutorial Videos

That's it for now!
